summary: Executed 38 external backend tests plus multi-role Playwright coverage for forgot-password, custom fees/partial payments/receipts/reminders, salary structure/LWP/payment/slips, admission pipeline, leave decisions, dark navigation, animated KPIs, PDFs, and legacy modules. Requested frontend flows passed. Backend passed 33/38; five security/data-integrity defects remain. Repeated Radix dialog accessibility warnings also remain.

critical.issue: Leave approval is not idempotent: approving the same leave twice returns success twice and reduced teacher leave_balance from 12 to 10. The test restored the original balance.
Fee creation accepts a nonexistent student_id, returns 200, and persists an orphan fee with blank student details. The test record was cleaned.
The API accepts duplicate salary generation for the same teacher and month; both calls return 200 and create separate payroll rows. Test records were cleaned.
Successful login still does not set an application access_token HttpOnly cookie; only the edge-provider __cf_bm cookie is returned.

minor.issue: Credentialed explicit-origin CORS playbook check fails: allow_credentials is false and the response uses Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.
Generated password-reset OTPs are written to application INFO logs in plaintext, exposing a live authentication secret to anyone with log access.

ui_bugs.component: Radix dialogs in Forgot Password, Fees, Salary, Enquiries and Leaves
ui_bugs.issue: Opening dialogs repeatedly logs a missing Description/aria-describedby accessibility warning. Functional behavior passes, but screen-reader context is incomplete.

action_items: Make leave decisions transition-safe/idempotent; only a pending leave may be decided, validate approved/rejected values, and decrement balance atomically once.
Validate fee student_id against the authenticated institute and return 404 before inserting when absent.
Add a unique teacher_id+month salary constraint and return 409 for duplicate generation.
Implement the required secure HttpOnly auth cookie and explicit credentialed CORS origins, or formally revise the auth playbook if Bearer-only localStorage is intentional.
Remove plaintext OTP logging and add reset-request/OTP-attempt rate limits.
Add DialogDescription or intentional aria-describedby handling to dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1603 lines and should be split into focused auth, finance, payroll, academics, communication, PDF, and seed modules.
create_fee looks up a student by id without institute scope or existence validation, directly causing orphan records and retaining cross-tenant IDOR risk if an external id leaks.
decide_leave uses an unconditional $inc whenever body.status is approved; it does not require current status=pending or validate allowed states.
SalaryStructure fields allow negative values, and create_salary has no database uniqueness guard for teacher/month.
Forgot-password stores OTP plaintext and logs it at INFO; store a keyed hash, never log the code, rate-limit issuance/verification, and expire records with a TTL index.
Synchronous requests calls for storage and Twilio run inside async handlers and can block the event loop.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested functional flows; one recurring low-priority accessibility warning

seed_data_creation: Created temporary API fee components, fees, salaries, rejected/approved leaves and enquiries; API fixtures cleaned them. UI created one Lab Fee component, one 2098-12 partial fee, one 2098-11 paid salary, one pipeline lead and one rejected leave; all five UI artifacts were deleted directly after verification. Teacher salary structure remains 30000 base + 8000 HRA + 4000 allowances - 2000 deductions as exercised.
test_credentials: Used principal and teacher credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Student STU26DDC67 was read from the live principal Students table and authenticated with the documented default password. /app/auth_testing.md is absent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend flows passed end-to-end: forgot-password advanced to OTP/new-password; custom fee reached partial with running paid/balance; reminder endpoints toasted success; receipt/slip buttons fetched 200 application/pdf and opened popups; salary structure/generation/payment passed; five-column lead stage/assignment passed; teacher apply and principal reject passed. Principal and student legacy module navigation loaded without webpack/ResizeObserver overlay. Added missing testids fee-month, fee-due-date, struct-allowances, struct-deductions, salary-month, enq-course and enq-notes and browser-verified them.
rca_of_the_issue: Data-integrity failures come from missing resource existence/uniqueness/state-transition checks: create_fee inserts after a non-scoped lookup that may return None; create_salary always inserts without a unique key; decide_leave unconditionally decrements balance on every approved request. Auth playbook failures are explicit implementation choices in code: login returns JWT JSON without set_cookie, and CORSMiddleware is configured allow_credentials=False with wildcard origin. OTP exposure is caused by logger.info of the generated code.
